notes.title: DevDays #1 | Season's Changes
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players! We have some great news for you that will make your gaming life even more exciting! In our game, we are proud to present a realistic seasonal system that has been carefully designed to make each season feel real!

What have we done?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535113/d5ede91b8a8e9c3d86167494deff245607eea00c.png
Imagine yourself waking up every morning in the game and the weather outside changing just as dynamically as in real life. With the arrival of winter, you will see the first snow gently falling on the ground, creating a magical atmosphere. With each new day, it will gradually accumulate, covering the landscape with a snow-white sheet. And what about spring? Flowers begin to bloom, birds return, and the world around is filled with the sounds of life!

🍁 Autumn will bring with it bright, saturated color palettes. Rains, the monotonous noise of which will become your most pleasant accompaniment, will add realism and immersion in the atmosphere!

But that's not all! For those who enjoy active recreation, we are working on leisure activities – 🦌 hunting adventures and fishing! Seasons will affect the behavior of animals, opening up new opportunities for hunting and fishing for you. Immerse yourself in exciting gameplay moments when you track game among snowy expanses or fish in one of the calm lakes in spring.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535113/8ce5dbcfc82abb5b496f495fea4d78346e6d5b86.png
We are confident that these elements will make the game truly unique and exciting. We are making every effort to create a world in which you can enjoy every moment and every seasonal change!

Stay with us, because there is still a lot of interesting things ahead! 💬 Don't forget to share your thoughts in the comments and stay tuned for further updates!

Together we will create an unforgettable gaming atmosphere! Thank you for your support! 🎮❤️
